title: Read done Notion pages with typed filters

conversation.text: Manual workflow: get all pages from my Notion database with ID 5b9e2c1d-0a7f-4c3e-9d21-7f6a8b9c0d1e where Status is Done, Completed is on or after 2026-09-01, and Owners includes the user with ID 7c3e1a2b-4d5f-4a6b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d (all three must match). Then for each page POST to https://reports.example.com/api/done as JSON: name (the page title), owners (the owners' email addresses as one comma-separated string) and completed (the Completed date as YYYY-MM-DD).

description: Notion filters are conditional on the property type (condition set, value field and value type), and the simplified output shape depends on the property type too (people become email arrays, dates become {start, end, time_zone} objects). Grades a three-condition AND filter on status, date and people properties, plus downstream reads of people and date values.

executionScenarios.name: filter-sent-and-values-read
executionScenarios.description: The query carries all three conditions and the POSTs carry the typed values.
executionScenarios.dataSetup: The Notion API data source query (POST /v1/data_sources/5b9e2c1d-0a7f-4c3e-9d21-7f6a8b9c0d1e/query) returns { "object": "list", "has_more": false, "next_cursor": null, "results": [{"object": "page", "id": "1f2a3b4c-5d6e-7f80-9123-456789abcdef", "url": "https://www.notion.so/1f2a3b4c5d6e7f809123456789abcdef", "properties": {"Name": {"id": "title", "type": "title", "title": [{"type": "text", "plain_text": "Ship billing v3", "text": {"content": "Ship billing v3"}}]}, "Status": {"id": "s", "type": "status", "status": {"name": "Done"}}, "Completed": {"id": "c", "type": "date", "date": {"start": "2026-09-10", "end": null, "time_zone": null}}, "Owners": {"id": "o", "type": "people", "people": [{"object": "user", "id": "7c3e1a2b-4d5f-4a6b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d", "name": "Dana Scully", "type": "person", "person": {"email": "dana@acme.test"}}, {"object": "user", "id": "9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-2c1d-0f9e8d7c6b5a", "name": "Fox Mulder", "type": "person", "person": {"email": "fox@acme.test"}}]}}}, {"object": "page", "id": "2a3b4c5d-6e7f-8091-2345-6789abcdef01", "url": "https://www.notion.so/2a3b4c5d6e7f809123456789abcdef01", "properties": {"Name": {"id": "title", "type": "title", "title": [{"type": "text", "plain_text": "Retire old API", "text": {"content": "Retire old API"}}]}, "Status": {"id": "s", "type": "status", "status": {"name": "Done"}}, "Completed": {"id": "c", "type": "date", "date": {"start": "2026-09-10", "end": null, "time_zone": null}}, "Owners": {"id": "o", "type": "people", "people": [{"object": "user", "id": "7c3e1a2b-4d5f-4a6b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d", "name": "Dana Scully", "type": "person", "person": {"email": "dana@acme.test"}}, {"object": "user", "id": "9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-2c1d-0f9e8d7c6b5a", "name": "Fox Mulder", "type": "person", "person": {"email": "fox@acme.test"}}]}}}] }. Return these raw API objects unchanged; the n8n node simplifies them itself. The reports endpoint returns 200 { "ok": true } for any POST.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: The Notion query filter ANDs Status status equals Done, Completed date on_or_after 2026-09-01, and Owners people contains 7c3e1a2b-4d5f-4a6b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d. Then two POSTs carry name 'Ship billing v3' and 'Retire old API', owners 'dana@acme.test, fox@acme.test' (or without the space), and completed '2026-09-10'. A missing or empty condition value, an email or name in the people condition, or an empty, undefined or '[object Object]' field FAILS.

outcomeExpectations: The Notion node filters on all three conditions combined with AND, with the people condition using the given user ID.
Downstream expressions read owners from the simplified people value as an array of emails and join them, and read completed from the start of the simplified date object.
